profile.headline: Experienced technical leader
profile.summary:
I am a strategic and results-oriented technical leader with extensive experience leading large teams, both as a director of engineering and as a principal engineer. I have a proven track record of establishing and executing on multi-year, multi-team technical strategy at scale.

My primary focus has been data, infrastructure, and platform teams. I have experience building software in-house, leveraging open-source software, and working with vendors. I am passionate about building high-performing teams that drive innovation and deliver measurable business value through technical excellence.

positions.title: Director of Software Engineering
positions.description:
Head of Data Platform. Directed 5 teams (~35 people across North America and Poland) responsible for data ingestion, storage, and transformation; job orchestration, ETL, and reverse ETL; data catalog and governance; product analytics; and CDP (customer data platform).

Led a large-scale multi-year modernization of our XX PB legacy Hive-based data platform. Migrated 10,000s of jobs to Databricks and onboarded 100s of users onto the new platform. Introduced data catalog and data governance tooling.

Oversaw vendor relations and negotiated contracts with major vendors including Databricks, Snowflake, Amplitude, and Segment.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Defined and championed a multi-year strategy for the evolution of our data platform and secured executive (S-team) alignment and support. Led a multi-vendor evaluation resulting in the selection of Databricks to replace our legacy Hadoop-based platform. This was implemented over the next two years (see Head of Data Platform item above).

Area tech lead for Product Platform, overseeing core Dropbox functionality, including sync, filesystem, sharing, identity, and previews. Defined multi-product technical strategy and presented to key executive stakeholders.

Head of CTO’s tech council. Led a group of staff and principal engineers to support our new CTO, developing recommendations for prioritizing technical debt across the company and setting technical strategy for platform development.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Combined Honours, Mathematics and Computer Science with Software Engineering Option
